about_short_description.short_description: Conduit is a platform for crypto native infrastructure.

product.name: Rollup Platform
product.description: A cloud platform for deploying and operating customizable Ethereum L2 and L3 rollups, with infrastructure for sequencing, monitoring, networking, and ecosystem tooling.

product.name: Developer Suite
product.description: An integrated toolkit for building and operating blockchain applications, combining RPC access, account abstraction, and blockchain data indexing through a unified platform.

product.name: RPC Nodes
product.description: Managed RPC infrastructure providing API access to Ethereum and supported rollups, with autoscaling capacity, redundancy, monitoring, and usage-based pricing.

product.name: Account Abstraction
product.description: Infrastructure for smart accounts, transaction bundling, gas sponsorship, and passkey or social-based onboarding on EVM rollups.

product.name: Conduit Indexing
product.description: A logs-based SQL data service for querying blockchain activity and analytics without repeated re-indexing, supporting high-throughput EVM chains.

product.name: G2 Sequencer
product.description: A dedicated sequencing service for rollups that processes transactions with high throughput, high availability, and configurable operational behavior.
